headword: {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}

definitions.explanation: The transfer of money from one bank account to another, either at the same bank or between different banks.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}っている→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: I pay the rent by bank transfer every month.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{振込先|ふりこみさき}→振込先：23203_furikomisaki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なります→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Bank transfer fees vary depending on the destination account.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧ (bank) and ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧ (transfer/deposit). Bank transfers remain one of the most common payment methods in Japan for rent, utility bills, online purchases, and business transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay by bank transfer
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: bank transfer fee
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: confirmation of bank transfer
- {銀行|ぎんこう}{振込|ふりこみ}⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧: bank transfer statement

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧: transfer/deposit (the general term)
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}{振替|ふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧: direct debit, automatic account transfer
- ⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧: remittance, sending money (broader term that includes international transfers)
